description: This file defines custom data frame classes for OpenAI Realtime API integration within the Pipecat project, specifically including 'RealtimeMessagesUpdateFrame' and 'RealtimeFunctionCallResultFrame' which represent updates to context messages and function call results, respectively. It also contains deprecation notices indicating the classes are no longer used in newer versions.

classes.name: RealtimeMessagesUpdateFrame
classes.description: Frame indicating that the realtime context messages have been updated. Contains a field 'context' referencing 'OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext'.

classes.name: RealtimeFunctionCallResultFrame
classes.description: Frame containing function call results for the realtime service. Contains a field 'result_frame' of type 'FunctionCallResultFrame'.
